mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a sweltering seventy-seven degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School tonight, feeling like eighty! That is way too sticky for a Wisconsin night. Under this New Moon, do not bother looking up, as there are no visible space station passes tonight. In local news, students can submit designs for the sticker contest through July twenty-second. Also, early voting starts July twenty-eighth at City Hall. In police news, a motorcycle without a license plate fled an officer, blowing through red lights. Finally, Culvers is closed right now but opens in the morning at ten AM, so look out for tomorrow's flavor, Snickers Swirl.
